Sales & Customer Support Specialist EMEA (m/w/d)
description:
IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email ----- with questions.

About Zello

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month. 

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

Zello keeps frontline teams connected with instant push-to-talk voice. Our customer base across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific is growing faster than separate sales and support queues can keep up with. This role owns the inbound experience for those customers end to end, from the first pricing question to the first support ticket, so new customers buy faster and stay longer. You'll be based in Munich, report to our Sales Leader EMEA, and work closely with our Account Executives, Support, and Customer Success teams.

After a successful first year, you will

  • Have owned inbound EMEA and APAC leads end to end, responding to every new inquiry within one business day and converting at least 20% of qualified leads into paying customers.

title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activiti

title: Regional Director - Enterprise
description:
Why Conduct

The world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas. Too often, they move at the speed of the systems they run on.

Behind every process change or new product line sits an SAP landscape shaped by decades of custom code and complexity. Changes take months. Migrations can cost more than $100 million and take years.

Conduct is building the AI operating system that makes this complexity understandable and actionable, so enterprises can move faster and pursue bigger ambitions. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems. We have secured partnerships with systems integrators and raised a $60 million Series A. Demand is outpacing our capacity to deliver.

The Role

Your opportunity is to win new ground for Conduct, land its most important customers, and build the team that makes it happen, inside a company in hyper-growth.

As Regional Director, Enterprise, you will recruit, develop and lead a high-performing sales team focused on winning Conduct's most strategic new enterprise accounts and bringing a new kind of technology to market. You will own recruitment, enablement and sales execution across your territory, building pipeline and coaching Enterprise Account Executives through complex buying processes.

The challenge is to build a team that earns the trust of major enterprises on decisions that matter to their business, and turns that trust into consistent wins. You will set the standard for how that team hires, develops and sells.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Join our Customer Success team, where you will focus on driving SaaS revenue growth through proactive customer engagement. While leveraging data insights, you will proactively identify upsell opportunities and mitigate churn risks. Your strategic guidance and deep product knowledge will be essential in helping customers unlock new value of our product and set them up for success.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

You guide and consult with them in order to drive their engagement and the activation of all the spend management features.

title: Stage - Assistant(e) Campaign Manager (H/F)
description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Campaign Manager pour rejoindre notre équipe CRM à l’occasion d’un stage d’une durée de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe CRM, vos principales responsabilités seront :

  • La création et la gestion de nos campagnes CRM omnicanales (Newsletters, SMS, Push notifications, communications in-app et WhatsApp) ;
  • L’analyse, le monitoring et l’optimisation des KPIs CRM au global ;
  • Le benchmark et la veille concurrentielle des meilleures pratiques du marché ;
  • L’excellence opérationnelle, notamment dans la coordination intra et inter-équipes.

Détail des missions: 

1. Gestion du Run & des campagnes automatisées

  • Plan d'animation commercial : déploiement et programmation des campagnes ponctue

title: Product Owner, Payments and Infrastructure
description:
About Flex

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: Remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

You will build Flex's payments infrastructure. You will lead our vendor strategy across acquiring, international money movement, and partner banks. You will architect how Flex orchestrates multiple payment providers across bank partners, processors, and international rails into a single elegant customer experience. And you will be the product partner on our transition from operating on partner licenses to operating on our own money transmitter licenses, which is a foundational shift in how Flex works.

À propos de PropertyOS

PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique.

Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier.

Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat.

🚀 Votre mission

En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution.

Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre :

  • Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative.
  • Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition.
  • Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS.
  • Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel.
  • Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés.

Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté.

💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats

Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance.

La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus.

title: Strategic Account Executive Okta

description:
Gestalte die Zukunft der öffentlichen Verwaltung mit uns!

Ayunis (ehem. Locaboo) ist ein führendes GovTech-Startup aus München mit über 900 Kunden (Städte, Gemeinden, Kommunen) in der DACH-Region.

Aber öffentlicher Sektor? Ist das nicht super-bürokratisch?

Das dachten wir zu Beginn auch. Doch der Sektor befindet sich stark im Wandel und du wirst bereits nach deinen ersten Gesprächen mit Kundinnen & Kunden merken, wie unglaublich offen und motiviert die Verwaltungsmitarbeitenden sind. Die Menschen dort sind einfach nur mega happy, dass sich bei der Digitalisierung endlich etwas tut.

Deine Rolle

Als Customer Support Manager:in für Locaboo bist du Teil des Account-Management-Teams und die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere mehr als 900 Bestandskunden in der DACH-Region. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen & Kunden aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung schnell, kompetent und freundlich weiterkommen – ob per Ticket, Telefon oder im persönlichen Support-Call.

Aber du bist mehr als nur ein Helpdesk: Du gestaltest aktiv unsere Wissensbasis mit, entwickelst Inhalte für die Locaboo Academy und trägst so dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen & Kunden die Software langfristig erfolgreich nutzen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kundinnen & Kunden, Account Management und Produkt bringst du wertvolles Feedback aus dem Alltag direkt ins Team.

Das sagt deine Kollegin

"Fast vier Monate bin ich inzwischen bei Ayunis, aber es fühlt sich an, als wäre ich schon viel länger Teil des Teams. Meine neuen Kolleg*innen haben es mir leicht gemacht, anzukommen. Die lockere Atmosphäre und die offene Kultur schätze ich sehr.
Die Zusammenarbeit mit Kund*innen aus dem öffentlichen Sektor war für mich Neuland. Umso spannender ist es, in diese Welt einzutauchen. Ich habe in der kurzen Zeit unglaublich viel gelernt: über GovTech, über KI, über Locaboo und sogar über mich

The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. title: Senior SAP S/4HANA CO / PS Consultant (Freelance)

For an international SAP S/4HANA transformation and rollout program, we are looking for an experienced Senior SAP CO / PS Consultant to support solution design, configuration, implementation, testing, and go-live activities.

Ideally, you bring strong expertise in both SAP CO and SAP PS. However, specialists with deep expertise in either area are also welcome, as the project is open to combining complementary skill sets.

Project Details

  • Duration: Expected until September/October 2027

  • Workload: Up to 100%

  • Location: Primarily remote, occasional on-site activities in Hanover, Germany

  • Languages: Fluent English; German preferred

  • Contract: Freelance

  • Europe-based candidates only

Your responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and implement SAP S/4HANA CO and/or PS processes.

  • Support Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Margin Analysis / CO-PA, Product Costing, and Material Ledger.

  • Prepare functional specifications, execute tests, analyze defects, and support cutover and hypercare.

  • Support ongoing operations alongside project implementation activities.
